reviews.comment: You didnt know what grade you got unless you went to office hours to get your test from him. He was a very kind old man and he did tell you the gist of what was going to be on the tests but it was not always entirely clear. Would take again but would definitely pay more attention to the material.

Lectures were a bit boring and very proof heavy because it derives directly from the textbook. Homework took some time but wasn't too bad and was graded fairly. The 2 midterms weren't too bad, just takes some time to study. The final is what struck almost everybody in the class. Nobody knew that we could use a calculator and it made the final hard.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is funny but does just read from textbook, homework is weekly and 30% of grade but you may or may not be able to get around doing it yourself.... Best part is he tells you exactly what will be on exams so helps studying so much and he grades very nice. I got some questions completely wrong and still got most of the points for the work i did.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Strong accent and lecture is only him going over theory, so most people do not attend. He goes over the questions that will be over the exam and they are similar to the homework questions. Sometimes homework can take a little but still not bad if you understand the material! An A or B is very possible.

Bro literally tells you exactly what questions are on the test without giving out numbers. Very generous partial credit on tests too, but the lectures are straight from the book and he was absent a lot

Pros: 
- Provides 'exam reviews' where he explains the exact questions on the upcoming exam.
- Very Generous on partial credit.
- Weekly homework (30% of the grade). Acts as a decent buffer for any missed points on exams. 

Cons:
- Lectures are read straight from the textbook so not helpful at all.
- Self-studying is a must for 90% of the course.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures are long and difficult to follow. The material taught is complex and covers a lot of material. Only graded on homework and exams. He does exam reviews which are super helpful!! He tries to help the students out and gives hints on what will be on exam. Amazing grader, lots of partial credit. Look up old TAMU math 304 exams for practice.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Linear Algebra can be tough, Dr. Grigorchuk's lectures were from the book and weren't great. Expect to learn some things on your own. Gives a test review before each exam telling you exactly what questions will be on the test. Gives very heavy partial credit and a bonus problem on each test. Calculator allowed on final. Best prof for your grade.

Lectures mostly read directly from the textbook, he can be hard to understand, often no explanation beyond the textbook, and sometimes the way he writes on the board can be hard to follow. These things were not ideal for me. No quizzes, weekly homework, and 3 exams which were moderately difficult but graded fairly. He's a very nice man though.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Tip: He writes his own homework questions but most of them come from the book or are very similar to questions in the book and a lot of those you can find help for online. 3 exams which are pretty difficult. Honestly this is a tough class but it's doable and he's a better choice than some of the others.

Good prof. Lectures are really helpful so don't skip. he gives weekly hw problems every tuesday so make a friend in case you skip and need to know the hw. Grades fairly and gives a lot of extra credit for showing work. Before exams he gives very helpful reviews of what problems and chapters to practice. Lecture follows book exactly. Very nice.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT
